build_robust_regression_stan_model: build a RobustRegression instance with model arguments to configure a Student-t errors linear model
format_data_to_stan: format an xarray Dataset into a Stan-ready dictionary with X design matrix and Y response values
extract_data_from_stan: extract Stan MCMC samples into an xarray Dataset with alpha, beta, nu, and sigma parameters
get_pars: get the list of parameter names needed from inference including alpha, beta, nu, and sigma
get_code: get the Stan model code string for a linear regression model with Student-t error distribution
